productFaqs.q: Can I run a tent heater off an EcoFlow at a {city} event?
productFaqs.a: A 1500 W ceramic heater pulls roughly 1500 Wh per hour — a Delta 3 Max (2048 Wh) gives you about 75 minutes of heat, and a Delta 3 Ultra (3072 Wh) about 2 hours. For all-evening heat in {city} we recommend our propane tent heaters; for short cocktail-hour warming or AV+light loads, the EcoFlows are silent and indoor-safe.

productFaqs.q: Is this safe to run inside a marquee tent or indoor venue in {city}?
productFaqs.a: Yes — EcoFlow power stations have zero emissions, near-silent operation (~30 dB in standby), and no fuel storage. They're rated for indoor use and we routinely deploy them inside enclosed marquees, banquet halls, and historic {city} venues that ban gas generators.

productFaqs.q: How long can I keep the rental for a {city} multi-day event?
productFaqs.a: Every battery has two rate tiers: a 2-day weekend rate (Friday delivery, Sunday pickup) and a weekly rate (5–7 day window) for festivals, week-long activations, or production schedules. Both include delivery, on-site walkthrough, and pickup in {city}.

productFaqs.q: Do I need the 220 W solar panel for a one-day event?
productFaqs.a: Usually no — a fully charged Delta 3 Max or Ultra will power most one-day {city} events on its own. The solar panel earns its keep on multi-day activations (festivals, week-long pop-ups) where you can't get to a wall outlet between days.

productFaqs.q: Can the Delta 3 Ultra really power a whole reception in {city}?
productFaqs.a: For lighting, AV, DJ, and small kitchen appliances — yes. With extra batteries it scales to 11 kWh, which covers a typical 5-hour reception with bistro lights, a sound system, and a coffee/dessert bar. For HVAC or large catering kitchens we still recommend grid power; we'll spec the right unit when you book.

productFaqs.q: Will Starlink work at my {city} venue?
productFaqs.a: Starlink needs a clear view of the sky — ideally pointing north with no large trees, buildings, or roof overhangs blocking the dish's field of view. The Starlink app has a built-in obstruction tool we can run during your {city} site visit. In dense forest or downtown alleys with tall buildings on all sides, performance can degrade. We'll flag any concerns during booking.

productFaqs.q: What speeds should I expect at a {city} event?
productFaqs.a: On the Roam plan with a clear sky, expect 100–200 Mbps download, 10–20 Mbps upload, and 25–50 ms latency. That's enough for Zoom calls, 4K video streaming, simultaneous DJ streaming + guest WiFi, livestream rigs, and credit-card payment terminals all running at the same time. We've stress-tested it at multiple {city} events with no degradation.

productFaqs.q: How long does setup take?
productFaqs.a: About 5 minutes once you place the dish. The Standard Actuated dish is self-aligning — you set it down with a clear view of the sky, plug in power, and it tilts itself to find the satellites. The router broadcasts WiFi within ~30 seconds of connecting. For {city} events we deliver it pre-configured and walk through setup with your crew on-site.

productFaqs.q: How does this work with our EcoFlow rental?
productFaqs.a: Starlink draws roughly 50–75 W continuous (peaks at ~150 W when the dish is melting snow). On a 2048 Wh Delta 3 Max that's 25–30 hours of continuous Starlink, or roughly 8 hours of Starlink + lighting + DJ at a typical {city} reception load. Most events power Starlink through the EcoFlow's USB-C or AC outlet — we'll confirm the right combo when you book.

productFaqs.q: What's the rental minimum?
productFaqs.a: Two-day weekend is the minimum (Friday delivery, Sunday pickup) — that's the same minimum as our power station rentals so {city} weekend events can book the kits together. For longer activations (festivals, week-long film shoots, multi-day production), we offer a weekly (5–7 day) rate that works out cheaper per day.

Audio isn't included in the kit; most {city} events run sound from a laptop, a portable speaker, or our other AV gear, and we're happy to advise on the right setup.

The projector pairs with our EcoFlow power stations so you can run a full backyard or park movie night with no wall outlet, and with one of our marquee tents you get a rain-proof screening either way.
